newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Zambia to sell sole local contract mining company.
newsitem.headline: Zambia to sell sole local contract mining company.

text.p: The Zambia Privatisation Agency (ZPA) said on Tuesday it was inviting offers for the purchase of up to eighty percent shares of the country's sole local contract mining company, Mpelembe Drilling Company Limited.
The mine, which is a 100 percent owned subsidiary of Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines, has a workforce of 1,483 permanent employees and 1,147 contract employees.
Prospective investors were invited to use their own technical expertise to propose the best approach and business plan for the mine, ZPA said in an advertisement in the South African press.
"A four month period is provided for investors due diligence during which bidders can investigate, review and evaluate all information and circumstances pertinent to the mine," it added.
